achievements.title: First Fren
achievements.description: Sign in with Discord and start your pond history.

achievements.title: Pond Pioneer
achievements.description: Had Discord linked to PepecoinHub on the day the Fren Passport opened. It cannot be earned any more.

achievements.title: Fresh Fren
achievements.description: Create and save your first custom Fren avatar.

achievements.title: Welcome Back!
achievements.description: Come back to PondOS on the day after your first visit (UTC days).

achievements.title: First Words
achievements.description: Send your first message in the lobby chat (LAN Party).

achievements.title: Hey @Fren
achievements.description: Mention another fren in the lobby chat with @ and their nickname.

achievements.title: Community Fren
achievements.description: Chat in the lobby on 5 different days (UTC days).

achievements.title: Dear Editor
achievements.description: Send your first letter to the editor.

achievements.title: Junior Editor
achievements.description: Get your first letter printed in The Pond Gazette.

achievements.title: Senior Editor
achievements.description: Get 5 of your letters printed in The Pond Gazette.

achievements.title: Vox Populi
achievements.description: Get 10 of your letters printed in The Pond Gazette.

achievements.title: I Voted
achievements.description: Vote in a Pond Poll, signed in with Discord.

achievements.title: 14-Day Streak
achievements.description: Open PondOS signed in with Discord on 14 days in a row (UTC days).

achievements.title: 30-Day Streak
achievements.description: Open PondOS signed in with Discord on 30 days in a row (UTC days).

achievements.title: Certified Fren
achievements.description: Be active in PondOS on 100 different UTC days (not necessarily in a row).

achievements.title: Old Frog
achievements.description: One year since your first Discord log-on to PepecoinHub.

achievements.title: Pepe Guesser
achievements.description: Make your first Pepe Guesser guess with a pin on the map.

achievements.title: Sharp Eye
achievements.description: Score a perfect 5000 in a daily Pepe Guesser hunt.

achievements.title: Detective Fren
achievements.description: Score a perfect 5000 in Pepe Guesser on 5 different days. Unlocks the detective hat and the suit.

achievements.title: Week Scout
achievements.description: Guess in Pepe Guesser on 7 days in a row (UTC days).

achievements.title: Scout Fren
achievements.description: Guess in Pepe Guesser on 14 days in a row (UTC days). Unlocks Lily's Explorer Pepe and the explorer hat.

achievements.title: Frog of the Week
achievements.description: Finish a Pepe Guesser week (Monday to Sunday, UTC) in first place. Can be won again.

achievements.title: Adept
achievements.description: Fly at least 3000 m in YEET THE PEP. Unlocks the Sunset avatar background.

achievements.title: NASA Is Hiring
achievements.description: Fly more than 5000 m in YEET THE PEP three times. Each flight counts once.

achievements.title: Moonwalker
achievements.description: Fly the full 6000 m in YEET THE PEP. A very rare stamp.

achievements.title: Happy Mining!
achievements.description: Make your first Pepe Miner cloud save. Unlocks the hard hat.

achievements.title: Good Game
achievements.description: Finish a board game (chess, checkers, Connect Four or Sea Battle) against another Discord fren. A resigned or abandoned game does not count.

achievements.title: Checkmate!
achievements.description: Win a game of chess by checkmate against another Discord fren.

achievements.title: Picasso Fren
achievements.description: Other players guess 10 of your drawings in Draw & Guess.

achievements.title: Podium
achievements.description: Finish in the top 3 of a Pepe Pictures game.

achievements.title: Game Night
achievements.description: Play in a scheduled Pepe Pictures game night.

achievements.title: Season Champion
achievements.description: Finish a ranked Pepe Pictures season in first place.

achievements.title: Quiz Master
achievements.description: Host a Pepe Pictures game with at least 4 ranked players.

achievements.title: Top 10
achievements.description: Reach the top 10 of the Pepe Guesser week board, the YEET board or the Pepe Pictures season ranking.

achievements.title: Arcade Hopper
achievements.description: Get a score recorded in 5 different PondOS games. Unlocks the headphones.

achievements.title: FUD Buster
achievements.description: Score 2,000 points or more in FUD Invaders.

achievements.title: Long Snake
achievements.description: Grow PEP Snake to 40 blocks or more.

achievements.title: Bug Hunter
achievements.description: Report a real bug that gets fixed. Given by the editor.

achievements.title: Beta Tester
achievements.description: Play an online FROGAGEDDON match during the beta.

achievements.title: First Hatch
achievements.description: Adopt your first PepeGochi.

achievements.title: Little Fren
achievements.description: Come back to your PepeGochi on a second day: it grows into a froglet.

achievements.title: One Small Step
achievements.description: Your PepeGochi grows up on its 7th care day. One small step for a man, one giant leap for a frog.

achievements.title: Good Parent
achievements.description: Keep your PepeGochi well cared for on 30 days.

achievements.title: Pond Decorator
achievements.description: Place 10 decorations in your PepeGochi room.

achievements.title: Secret Starter
achievements.description: Find your first PondOS secret.

achievements.title: Treasure Hunter
achievements.description: Find 6 different PondOS secrets.

achievements.title: The Secret Pond
achievements.description: Put together all 6 pieces of the lost pond map.

achievements.title: Frogmas
achievements.description: Visit PondOS on 24, 25 or 26 December (UTC).

achievements.title: BALI
achievements.description: $0.01 - BALI. A mythic stamp for every fren when Pepecoin reaches $0.01 USD. Server verified; reserved until then.

secrets.title: Why Do You Need This?
secrets.description: Some addresses are not for you. Or are they?

secrets.description: Somebody wrote the words down. Say one out loud.

secrets.hint: Something is wrong with this computer.
secrets.description: Some commands should never be typed. Try one anyway.

secrets.title: Midnight Fren
secrets.hint: The screensaver knows more than it says.

secrets.title: Paper Crown

items.description: A souvenir from a real 6000 m YEET flight.

items.title: Old Floppy
